definitions.explanation: A formal meeting in which someone is asked questions, typically for employment or admission purposes. In Japan, the interview process is often rigorous and includes multiple rounds.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}、{面接|めんせつ}があります。
{面接|めんせつ}はうまくいきましたか。
{面接|めんせつ}で{緊張|きんちょう}しました。
examples.english: I was nervous during the interview.

notes: 面接 is commonly used as a suru verb (面接する - to interview). Related terms include 面接官 (めんせつかん - interviewer), 面接試験 (めんせつしけん - oral examination), and 集団面接 (しゅうだんめんせつ - group interview).
